title: BROKEN Construction Method NO REQUIREMENTS | Runescape: Dragonwilds
author: RS AFKing
description:
In this video I show you how to get 900K XP Per Hour in the Construction Skill for Runescape: Dragonwilds and it's easier than you think!

transcript.text: What's going on AFK Army, and welcome to my guide on how to power level your construction in Runescape Dragon Wilds.
Let's jump straight into some of the buffs we're going to need to get this rolling. There are three boosts that are
all additive for up to 45% increase to your base XP per hour. Those boosts start with the inspiring ring of
construction, which increases your construction XP by 5%. Now, this is the lowest of the boost, but it does last
the longest of all the boosts we're going to talk about. The next boost is going to be one of these foods. Either
of these foods will increase your experience gained by 10% to a varying length between 300 seconds and 600
seconds, or 5 and 10 minutes. Lastly, any of these potions, which will give us the biggest increase of all, the
construction potions. Now, there are several tiers here, which will increase your construction XP from anywhere
between 15% and 30% for either 300 seconds or 600 seconds. Now, you can use none of these
boosts. It just depends on what you have access to at your level and your progression through the game. The method
we're going to use here does not depend on any of these to be used, and can be done at level one construction with very
little progression through the game. As long as you have access to coarse thread
and rough cloth, you can do this method. Which means all you need is the spinning wheel unlocked to spin your flax or
coarse animal fur into the coarse thread and the loom for the rough cloth. Now, let's get into the method. To get things
started, you need to build a basic structure just like this, three walls and a roof. Uh do not put a floor down.
You we're counting on this being on the ground. It has to be on the ground. Now, in our build menu, this is what we're
going to be building. We're going to be building, in the decorations tab, we're going to be building simple rugs. And
you can see that these rugs, when you stack them on top of one another, they get unstable really quick. And as you
get going three or four deep, they break. And you get the XP for them, and they just keep breaking. And so, you can sit
here and spam the rugs, and it'll keep breaking, and you can keep building. And this is going to be our method right
here, okay? This is what we're going to do. This is how we're going to go from wherever you're at to level 99
construction. And I'm going to show you just how much XP per hour [music] you can get, and how long it's going to take
you to go from wherever you're at to 99. This is your reminder to like and subscribe.
Let's go ahead and bring a timer over here. Now that we've got the timer over here, we can go ahead and pop the
boosts, and we're going to run this for 10 minutes, and see what our XP per hour is in the
10 minutes. And then we'll do some math.
All right. All right. That was 10 minutes, and we got 149,000 XP.
Nice. All right. So, now that we know that we get 149,000 and I'm just going to use do simple
math. Let's just call it 150,000 because I'm sure I missed a couple of clicks there. 150,000 times six
900,000 XP per hour.
That is amazing. All right. Well, there you have it, gamers. Levels 1 to 99 in about an hour and 10 minutes. That's
pretty freaking crazy. 900,000 XP per hour. I had no idea what we were going to end up with. I knew it was
going to be a lot, but wow, that is a lot of XP per hour. Probably the fastest skill in RuneScape Dragon Wilds to go
from levels 1 to 99. If you guys like this video and you want to see more like it, be sure to smash that bell and
subscribe and I'll catch you in the world of Gielinor.
